user.title: Hauswacht
user.description: Set up the Hauswacht intrusion alarm. The alarm starts disarmed. Sirens are not controlled in this version.

init.title: Hauswacht options
init.description: {saved}Every change is saved as soon as you submit the form; you then return to the menu.

code.title: PIN rules
code.description:
Users with a PIN: {pin_users}.

**Master PIN:** a simple PIN without separate users, e.g. so voice assistants (Alexa) can only disarm with a PIN. It also appears in the user list as “Master-PIN”.

As soon as a PIN exists, the panel requires it to disarm. With “Allow dashboard buttons despite PIN”, the dashboard buttons “Disarm now” and “End alarm” keep working – only logged-in Home Assistant users can reach them anyway.

⚠️ **Important:** As soon as **one** PIN exists, the panel (and Alexa) require a PIN to disarm – **from everyone**. People without a PIN can then only disarm via dashboard buttons (if allowed under PIN rules) or the push button. So: give everyone a PIN (shared PIN allowed) or no one.

data.end_alarm_without_pin: End alarm without PIN (sirens off, system stays armed)
data.buttons_without_pin: Allow dashboard buttons despite PIN (PIN then only protects the panel and voice assistants)

profile_settings.title: Alarm profile {profile}
profile_settings.description: Name, icon and optionally a button on the alarm panel. Each button can belong to one profile only; profiles without a button are armed via the "Profile" select and the "Arm" buttons.

automation.name: Automation
automation.description: Optional: when this profile arms or disarms by itself. Automatic arming only happens from "disarmed"; open sensors are never bypassed automatically. A running alarm is never ended automatically.

data.auto_away_persons: Arm when all of these persons are away
data.auto_disarm_on_arrival: Disarm when one of these persons arrives home

data_description.auto_away_delay: Phones detected only via Wi-Fi sometimes briefly report "away" in standby. The delay prevents accidental arming.
data_description.auto_disarm_on_arrival: Only if the profile was armed automatically. Note: whoever has one of these phones can disarm with it.

data_description.zones: Each sensor of these zones triggers on its own (door with entry delay, window instantly …). Open sensors of these zones prevent arming.
data_description.rules: These rules apply in addition. Sensors that only appear in rules do not prevent arming; an open window only counts once it closes and opens again.

zones.title: Zones
zones.description:
{saved}A **zone** is a group of sensors that are always monitored together – for example:

- **Perimeter**: all door and window contacts (with their tamper sensors)
- **Inside** or **Basement**: motion and presence sensors

In the **profiles** you then choose which zones are armed: "Home" = perimeter only, "Away" = perimeter and inside.

Every sensor belongs to **exactly one** zone. Hauswacht only monitors sensors that are in a zone.

zone_add.title: Add zone
zone_add.description:
Select all sensors that belong to this zone. How a sensor triggers (door with entry delay, window instantly, motion, tamper) is derived from its device class – exceptions under "Sensor roles".

Each sensor can only be in **one** zone.

data.name: Zone name (e.g. Perimeter, Inside, Basement)
data.label: Additionally all sensors with this label (optional)

data_description.entities: Door, window, motion, presence and tamper sensors (binary sensors).
data_description.label: Handy for many sensors: put the label directly on the sensor entity (not the device); new sensors with the label then belong to the zone automatically.

zone_edit_settings.title: Zone {zone}
zone_edit_settings.description:
Select all sensors that belong to this zone. How a sensor triggers (door with entry delay, window instantly, motion, tamper) is derived from its device class – exceptions under "Sensor roles".

Each sensor can only be in **one** zone.

data.name: Zone name (e.g. Perimeter, Inside, Basement)
data.label: Additionally all sensors with this label (optional)

data_description.entities: Door, window, motion, presence and tamper sensors (binary sensors).
data_description.label: Handy for many sensors: put the label directly on the sensor entity (not the device); new sensors with the label then belong to the zone automatically.

zone_delete.title: Delete zone
zone_delete.description: The zone is also removed from all profiles.

infrastructure.title: Monitor radio networks and gateways
infrastructure.description:
Select sensors that report whether a radio network or gateway is running – e.g. the connection state of the Zigbee2MQTT bridge or an MQTT broker. If such a system fails, all sensors behind it can no longer report. Hauswacht reports the fault and treats arming as with unavailable sensors.

For sensors of type “problem”, “on” means fault; for all others “on” means OK.

data.infrastructure: Status sensors of radio networks and gateways

sirens.title: Alarm devices – sirens
sirens.description: Register the sirens Hauswacht may use for intrusion alarms. Fire safety: Hauswacht never switches a siren on or off while any smoke detector reports fire, or while the fire state of a registered siren is unknown. Siren control stays LOCKED until you enable it here and confirm.

data.confirm_hardware: I confirm: real sirens may sound during an alarm

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: General recipients get every message for which the event has no recipients of its own. Alarm, door opened and alarm ended go to the profile's recipients first. Buttons in notifications only work with the Home Assistant app.

data.critical_alerts: Alarm and duress as critical alerts (break through Do Not Disturb)

data_description.critical_alerts: iPhone: critical alert (allow once in the app). Android: channel "alarm_stream" – rings even when silenced.

event_alarm.name: Alarm
event_alarm.description: Burglar alarm triggered. Goes to the profile's recipients first.

event_entry.name: Door opened (entry delay)
event_entry.description: When an entry door opens while armed. Default: only with the push button. Profile recipients first.

event_alarm_ended.name: Alarm ended
event_alarm_ended.description: Who ended the alarm. Profile recipients first.

event_arm_failed.name: Arming rejected
event_arm_failed.description: With the buttons "Arm anyway" (only if open sensors may be bypassed) and "Try again".

event_reminder.name: Reminder
event_reminder.description: "Everyone away, system disarmed" with button "Arm now". Set up under "Reminder".

reminder.name: Reminder "everyone away"
reminder.description: If all selected persons are away and the system is disarmed, a single reminder with the button "Arm now" is sent after the delay. Hauswacht does not switch anything by itself. Unknown location does not count as away.

event_unconfirmed.name: Unconfirmed trigger
event_unconfirmed.description: A rule was started but not fulfilled in time (e.g. only the door) – there was no alarm. Default: off.

event_unconfirmed_frequent.name: Sensor often triggers alone
event_unconfirmed_frequent.description: The same sensor started a rule three times within an hour that was not fulfilled – a hint to check it. Default: off.

homecoming.title: Homecoming observation
homecoming.description: Hauswacht records when entry doors open and people are detected as home – per location source – and calculates whether automatic homecoming would be reliable. The observation switches NOTHING: no disarm, no alarm. Press “Homecoming report” for the report.

users.title: Users and PINs
users.description:
{saved}Several people with their own PIN. Several users may share a PIN – Hauswacht then shows “shared PIN (…)”. An action is allowed if at least one user with that PIN may do it.

⚠️ **Important:** As soon as **one** PIN exists, the panel (and Alexa) require a PIN to disarm – **from everyone**. People without a PIN can then only disarm via dashboard buttons (if allowed under PIN rules) or the push button. So: give everyone a PIN (shared PIN allowed) or no one.

**Valid from/until:** for guests – outside this time the PIN is blocked.

rules.title: Rules
rules.description: {saved}A **rule** triggers only on a sequence of sensors, e.g. “front door, then basement within 120 s” – door alone or basement alone then trigger nothing. Rules stand on their own; each alarm profile chooses which apply. Rules are OR-combined: a rule can only trigger an alarm, never prevent another rule's alarm.

rule_delete.description: The rule is also removed from all alarm profiles.

rule_settings.title: Rule
rule_settings.description: Steps in order: step 2 must be fulfilled within the time of step 1, step 3 within the time of step 2 and so on. Empty steps are ignored. Sensors can be single entities and/or whole zones.

data_description.within: The next step must be fulfilled within this time after this step. For a first step with “all” or “at least N” also: how close its sensors must be.

users_without_pin.title: Hauswacht: not everyone has a PIN
users_without_pin.description:
As soon as a PIN exists, the panel (and Alexa) require it **from everyone** to disarm. These people have no PIN and cannot disarm there: **{people}**.

Options:
- Give them a PIN under Hauswacht → Configure → System settings → Users and PINs (a shared family PIN is allowed), or
- enable “Allow dashboard buttons despite PIN” under PIN rules (currently: {buttons}) – dashboard buttons and the push button then keep working without a PIN.

Scheduled profiles and presence automation are not affected.
